criteria.statement: Hydrological modeling bridges GIS elevation grids with parametric road cross-fall and drainage gullies based on verified local stormwater engineering patterns.

evidence.observed: Hydrological modeling explicitly couples terrain DEM D8 flow with roadway cross-fall slopes, gutter spread width constraints, and gully spacing optimization based on SmartGully and Storm Drainage Calculation Dashboard patterns.
